correctness.rationale: For the exact RKL2 stability polynomial R3(z)=1+z+z^2/2+z^3/15 and Q=[[-1,1,0],[0,-1,1],[0,0,0]], direct multiplication gives R3(hQ)=[[r(h),h(1-h+h^2/5),h^2(1/2-2h/15)],[0,r(h),1-r(h)],[0,0,1]], with r(h)=1-h+h^2/2-h^3/15. Factoring the two independent offdiagonal signs proves exactly [0,(5-sqrt(5))/2] union [(5+sqrt(5))/2,15/4], with r(h) and 1-r(h) positive over the candidate interval using the Legendre bound for 0<=h<=5. For every finite Markov generator, R2(hQ) has strictly positive diagonal entries and offdiagonal entries h(q_ij+h(Q^2)_ij/2), each with a nonnegative initial interval. On at most two states Q^2=-lambda Q; for R3 the offdiagonal multiplier 1-r(lambda h) stays nonnegative and diagonal positivity cannot return after z>=5. Strict signs at h=3,3.7,4 establish robustness for a neighborhood of the two birth rates. Independent SymPy exact matrix computation confirms the three diagnostic step signs. This proves endpoint positivity only, not positivity of internal stages.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate only bounded cases; infinite/all-parameter assertions rest on reconstructed proof.
